items.headline: Lula Secures Re-Election in Brazil's Presidential Runoff
items.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a historic re-election victory over right-wing rival Flávio Bolsonaro in a closely contested runoff vote. The outcome shapes the political and economic landscape of South America's largest nation as opposition allies challenge the final tally.

items.headline: Cyberattack Forces New Mexico's Largest Hospital System to Divert Ambulances
items.summary: On October 26, 2026, the University of New Mexico Health System suffered a major cybersecurity breach that forced emergency patients to be diverted and canceled appointments across more than 30 clinics. The incident temporarily disrupted operations at the state's only Level 1 trauma center, emphasizing the severe public safety risks of digital attacks on healthcare infrastructure.

items.headline: Harry Kane Wins 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or as Alexia Putellas Claims Women's Trophy
items.summary: England captain Harry Kane won the 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium on Monday, becoming the first English footballer to claim the award since Michael Owen in 2001. Spain's Alexia Putellas secured the Women's Ballon d'Or for the third time, highlighting a star-studded evening honoring football's top global performers.

items.headline: Final Screen Tests Reportedly Underway for Next James Bond
items.summary: Amazon MGM Studios has reportedly begun final screen tests in London to select the actor who will portray the next James Bond in director Denis Villeneuve's upcoming film. Contenders including Jack Lowden, Callum Turner, and Josh O'Connor are participating in auditions evaluating their action stunts, camera presence, and dialogue.
